default.description: Default returned when key is missing (get)

tools.name: memory_mutate
tools.description: Mutate existing in-memory variables (insert, remove, update, increment, toggle, etc.).

tools.name: create_variable
tools.description: Create a new object or variable in memory with a given name and value. Supports all JSON types: strings, numbers, objects, arrays, booleans, and null.

name.description: The name of the variable to create

value.description: The value to assign (can be any JSON type: string, number, object, array, boolean, or null)

type.description: Optional type hint for the variable (e.g., 'string', 'number', 'object', 'array', 'boolean')

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite if variable already exists (default: false)

tools.name: debt_analyst_agent
tools.description: AI agent that automatically discovers and reads facts from blackboard variables in memory, then generates debt analysis hypotheses using DeepSeek reasoning model. Can auto-discover variables with 'facts' property.

blackboard_key.description: Optional: The key in memory store containing facts/data to analyze. If not provided, tool will auto-discover variables with 'facts' property or variables named 'blackboard'

context.description: Additional context or specific question for the debt analyst

api_key.description: OpenRouter API key (optional, can be set via environment variable OPENROUTER_API_KEY)

save_to.description: Optional key to save the hypothesis results to in memory store

timeout.description: API request timeout in seconds (default: 120). Increase if using reasoning models that need more time.

enable_self_critique.description: Enable automatic self-critique to iteratively improve the analysis (default: false)

max_iterations.description: Maximum number of critique-refinement iterations when self-critique is enabled (default: 2)

tools.name: liquidity_analyst_agent
tools.description: AI agent that analyzes liquidity positions, cash flow, and working capital from blackboard data using AI reasoning.

blackboard_key.description: Optional: The key in memory store containing facts/data to analyze. Auto-discovers if not provided.

context.description: Additional context or specific question for the liquidity analyst

api_key.description: OpenRouter API key (optional, can be set via environment variable)

save_to.description: Optional key to save the analysis results to in memory store

enable_self_critique.description: Enable automatic self-critique to iteratively improve the analysis (default: false)

max_iterations.description: Maximum number of critique-refinement iterations when self-critique is enabled (default: 2)

tools.name: qoe_analyst_agent
tools.description: AI agent that performs Quality of Earnings (QoE) analysis, evaluating earnings quality, sustainability, and potential red flags.

blackboard_key.description: Optional: The key in memory store containing facts/data to analyze. Auto-discovers if not provided.

context.description: Additional context or specific question for the QoE analyst

api_key.description: OpenRouter API key (optional, can be set via environment variable)

save_to.description: Optional key to save the analysis results to in memory store

enable_self_critique.description: Enable automatic self-critique to iteratively improve the analysis (default: false)

max_iterations.description: Maximum number of critique-refinement iterations when self-critique is enabled (default: 2)

tools.name: asset_quality_analyst_agent
tools.description: AI agent that analyzes asset quality, performing risk assessment on loans, investments, and other assets.

blackboard_key.description: Optional: The key in memory store containing facts/data to analyze. Auto-discovers if not provided.

context.description: Additional context or specific question for the asset quality analyst

api_key.description: OpenRouter API key (optional, can be set via environment variable)

save_to.description: Optional key to save the analysis results to in memory store

enable_self_critique.description: Enable automatic self-critique to iteratively improve the analysis (default: false)

max_iterations.description: Maximum number of critique-refinement iterations when self-critique is enabled (default: 2)

tools.name: consolidated_analyst_critique
tools.description: Batch critique multiple analyst responses together for cost efficiency. Analyzes all analyst outputs (debt, liquidity, QoE, asset quality) simultaneously to identify conflicts, gaps, and provide consolidated feedback.

analyst_responses.description: Array of analyst response objects with agent type and response content

agent.description: Type of analyst (debt_analyst, liquidity_analyst, qoe_analyst, asset_quality_analyst)

response.description: The analysis response text from the analyst

response_key.description: Optional memory key where response is stored

critique_mode.description: Mode of critique: cross_analysis (check consistency across analysts), conflicts_only (identify contradictions), comprehensive (detailed review)

use_cheap_model.description: Use cost-efficient model (gpt-4o-mini) instead of reasoning model for critique (default: true)

context.description: Additional context about the company or analysis scenario

api_key.description: OpenRouter API key (optional, can be set via environment variable)

save_to.description: Optional key to save the consolidated critique to in memory store

tools.name: critic_agent
tools.description: AI agent that critically evaluates and provides feedback on other agents' responses, hypotheses, and analyses. Identifies weaknesses, logical gaps, unsupported claims, and suggests improvements. Can be used iteratively to refine agent outputs.

response_to_critique.description: The response, hypothesis, or analysis to critique. Can be text or a memory key containing the response.

blackboard_key.description: Optional: The key in memory store containing the original facts/data that the response was based on. Helps provide context for critique.

critique_focus.description: Optional: Specific aspects to focus on (e.g., 'logical consistency', 'evidence quality', 'completeness', 'assumptions', 'risk assessment')

context.description: Additional context about what type of analysis this is (e.g., 'debt analysis', 'liquidity analysis', 'QoE analysis')

api_key.description: OpenRouter API key (optional, can be set via environment variable)

save_to.description: Optional key to save the critique results to in memory store
